paite: Himahleh huchi in ka chi ahi, Gouluah dingpa bangkim tung ah toupa himahleh naupang ahih lai teng sikha toh bangmah in akilamdang kei;
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

paite: apa hun seh ahong tun masiah achilpa leh akempa nuai ah a-om hi.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

paite: Huchibang in ei leng naupang i hih lai in, khovel thubulte nuai ah sikha in i om uhi.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

paite: Himahleh ahunbi ahong kim in, Pathian in a Tapa, numei suan in, dan nuai a hong suak in ahon sawlkhia hi;
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

paite: ta hihna i muhtheihna ding leh dan nuai a omte tankhe ding in.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

paite: Huan tate na hih ziak un Pathian in a Tapa Kha, "Abba, Pa,” chi a kikou in, i lungtang uah ahon sawl hi.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Abba is a Greek spelling for the Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy” used in a familiar, respectful, and loving way. Father!”

paite: Huchi in sikha na hita kei ua, ta na hi zawta uhi; huan ta na hihleh Pathian vang a gouluah ding na hi uhi.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

paite: Hinapi, tuma Pathian na theih louh lai un, apiandan mawng ua pathian hilou hialte sikha na hi uhi.
heading: Paul In Galatiate Awlmohna
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

paite: Himahleh tu a Pathian na hon theih nung un bel, ahihkeileh Pathian theihmi na hong hih nung un chih ding ahi zaw; thubul zawngkhal leh namanloute nuai a bangchidan a bawi a tan ut nawn na hi ua?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

paite: Nite, khate, hunte, kumte na tang zel ua.
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

paite: Na tung uah tha ka sengthawn kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

paite: Unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, keimah bang in om un, kei leng noumau bang in ka om a, ka bangmah na hihse kei uhi.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

paite: Tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gen masakna pen ka sa hat louh ziak ahi chih na thei uhi.
english: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

paite: Huan ka sa a nou a dia khemna om tuh na simmoh kei ua, na kih sam kei uh; Pathian angel bang leh Khrist Jesu bang hial in na hon pakta zaw uhi.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

paite: Vangpha na kisakna uh koi a omta ahia le? Hihtheih liai hileh na mit uh khelkhia in na hon pe khin ding uh chih ka hon theihpih ahi.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

paite: Thutak ka hon hilh ziak in na melma uh ka hong hita a hia?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

paite: Amau noute phatuamngaitak in, ahoih lam deih hilou napi in ahon zol ua; ahi, amau a dia phattuam na ngaih theihna ding ua koute a kipan posiah a hon omsak a-ut uhi.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

paite: Atup ahoih nakleh ahoih lam ah chik lai peuh in phatuamngaih gige ahoih hi, na kiang ua ka om lai kia hilou in.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

paite: Ka unaute aw, Khrist noumau a siam piching a a-om masiah nauvei in ka hon vei hi.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

paite: Ahi, tulai in na kiang ua om a, ka awsuah hihlamdan ka ut theihdan; na tungthu uah ka mang abang ahi.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

paite: Dan nuai a om utte aw, hon hilh un, dan in agen na thei kei ua hia?
heading: Sarah Leh Hagar Etsakna
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

paite: Hichibang a gelh ahi: Abraham in tapa nih anei a, khat sikhanu toh khat noplennu toh ahi.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.

paite: Himahleh sikhanu lak a pen sadan in apiang a, noplennu lak a pen bel thuchiam ziak a piang ahi.
english: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

paite: Huai thilte etsakna ahi, huai numeite thukhun nih ahi uh; khat Sinai Tang a sikha hi ding a ta neinu, Hagar ahi.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

paite: Huan Hagar bel Arabia gam a Sinai Tang ahi a, tulai a om Jerusalem toh kibang ahi, atate toh sikha in a-om uhi.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

paite: Tunglam Jerusalem bel noplen ahi; huai ngeingei eite nu ahi.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

paite: "Nang chiing, ta nei ngei lou, nuam in, nang, nauvei ngei lou, kikoukhia in; pasal neinu sang in lungzuangnu tate tamzaw ding ahi ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break forth and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.” Isaiah 54:1

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, eite Isak bang in thuchiam tate i hi uhi.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

paite: Himahleh huai lai bang in tu in leng ahi; sadan a piang in Khadan a piang asawi ahi.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

paite: Himahleh Laisiangthou in bangchi in agen a? "Bawinu atapa toh hawlkhia un; bawinu tapa in noplennu tapa gou aluahpih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.” Genesis 21:10

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, bawinu tate i hi kei ua, noplennu tate i hi zaw uhi.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.
